title: Largest Of Three
description:
## Task

Return the largest of three integers.

## Input

- `a`, `b`, `c` — integers. Any of them may be equal.

## Output

An integer: the largest of the three.

## Example

```python
max_of_three(4, 9, -2)  # returns 9
max_of_three(-7, -7, -8)  # returns -7
```

## Constraints

- -10^9 ≤ `a`, `b`, `c` ≤ 10^9
signature: def max_of_three(a: int, b: int, c: int) -> int
